Frequently asked questions

Quick answers about our occupational health and healthcare services. Can't find yours? Write to us.

Contact us
What is HealthAxis Healthcare Pvt Ltd?

HealthAxis Healthcare Pvt Ltd is a healthcare services company based in Ambethan, Khed, Pune, Maharashtra. It provides integrated healthcare and occupational health services to corporates and IT companies, institutions and schools, manufacturing units and communities, with a focus on preventive and proactive care.

Which healthcare services does HealthAxis offer?

HealthAxis offers nine services: medical manpower (doctors, nurses and paramedical staff), occupational health centre (OHC) set up and operations, corporate health check-ups, corporate preventive vaccination camps, healthcare awareness sessions, BLS and ACLS training, ambulance services, diagnostics, and biomedical waste management.

Can HealthAxis set up and run an occupational health centre at our workplace?

Yes. HealthAxis provides end-to-end setup and management of occupational health centres (OHC), along with statutory compliance support.

What health check-ups does HealthAxis provide for employees?

HealthAxis provides annual health check-ups (AHC), pre-employment health check-ups (PEHC) and customized health packages for corporate teams.

Does HealthAxis organise vaccination camps at workplaces?

Yes. Its corporate preventive vaccination camps include employee vaccination programs, on-site vaccination camps, and disease prevention and immunization drives.

Does HealthAxis offer BLS and ACLS training with certification?

Yes. HealthAxis runs Basic Life Support (BLS) and Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) sessions with hands-on practical training and certification programs.

Is the HealthAxis ambulance service available 24/7?

HealthAxis offers 24/7 emergency response with basic and advanced life support ambulances, each staffed by a trained medical team.

Does HealthAxis handle biomedical waste?

Yes. HealthAxis manages the collection, segregation and disposal of biomedical waste in compliance with regulatory guidelines, using safe and environment-friendly solutions.

Who does HealthAxis work with?

HealthAxis works with corporates and IT companies, institutions and schools, manufacturing units, and communities. Medical staff can be deployed on-site or off-site, and solutions are customized to each organisation.

How can I contact HealthAxis or request a service?

Email Info@healthaxis.co.in or call +91 91122 19600. The office is at Shop No. 2, Manjare Complex, Ambethan (Opp. Advil Company), Tal. Khed, Dist. Pune - 410501, Maharashtra.
